label: Census GEOID
description: 10-digit Census county subdivision code. The key every source is joined on.

label: NJ municipal code
description: New Jersey's 4-digit municipal code (county + town).

label: Municipality
description: Municipality name with its type (Borough, Township, City, Town, Village).

label: Type
description: Form of municipality.

label: County
description: County name.

label: County FIPS
description: 5-digit county FIPS code.

label: Population
description: Total population.

label: Households
description: Occupied housing units.

label: Renter households
description: Renter-occupied housing units.

label: Town median household income
description: Median household income of the town's residents (B19013).

label: Margin of error
description: 90% margin of error of town median household income.

label: Top-coded
description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $250,000.

label: ACS median home value
description: Median value of owner-occupied homes, as estimated by owners (B25077).

label: Margin of error
description: 90% margin of error of the ACS median home value.

label: Top-coded
description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $2,000,000.

label: Median gross rent
description: Median monthly rent plus utilities paid by renters (B25064).

label: Margin of error
description: 90% margin of error of median gross rent.

label: Top-coded
description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $3,500.

label: Renters paying 30%+ of income
description: Share of renter households (with computed ratio) paying 30% or more of their own income on rent (B25070).

label: Margin of error
description: Approximate 90% margin of error of the cost-burdened share.

label: County median household income
description: Median household income of the county. The income used in both scores.

label: Margin of error
description: 90% margin of error of county median household income.

label: Average residential property tax bill
description: Average total property tax on a residential property, before credits and deductions.

label: Tax year
description: Tax year of the property tax data.

label: State-assessed average residential value
description: DCA average residential assessment divided by the town's equalization ratio: an average market value from tax assessments, not a median. Used as the home value only where the Census has none.

label: HUD area
description: HUD Fair Market Rent / income limit area containing the town.

label: HUD 80% income limit (4 people)
description: HUD low-income limit (80% of area median income) for a four-person household.

label: HUD Fair Market Rent, 2 bedrooms
description: Area-wide Fair Market Rent for a two-bedroom home.

label: Zillow Home Value Index
description: Empty: Zillow is not published until its terms are confirmed.

label: ZHVI month
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: Zillow matching method
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: Zillow regions used
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: ZHVI 1-year change
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: ZHVI 5-year change
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: Typical home value (used)
description: The home value used for owning costs: Zillow if cleared, else the ACS median, else the DCA equalized average.

label: Home value source
description: Which source home_value came from.

label: Home value data period
description: Data period of home_value.

label: Zillow and ACS disagree
description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

label: Mortgage rate used
description: 30-year fixed rate: mean of the latest four weekly Freddie Mac PMMS readings.

label: Mortgage payment, per year
description: Principal and interest on home_value with 20% down, 30-year fixed at mortgage_rate_pct.

label: Ownership cost, per year
description: annual_mortgage_pi + avg_property_tax_bill. Leaves out insurance, PMI, HOA fees, maintenance, utilities.

label: Rent, per year
description: 12 x median_gross_rent.

label: Cost to own ÷ county income
description: annual_ownership_cost / county_median_hh_income. The measure behind the ownership score.

label: Rent ÷ county income
description: annual_rent / county_median_hh_income. The measure behind the rental score.

label: Renters paying 30%+ (measure copy)
description: Same as renters_cost_burdened_share; context only, not scored.

label: Cost to own ÷ town income
description: annual_ownership_cost / town_median_hh_income. Display only.

label: Rent ÷ town income
description: annual_rent / town_median_hh_income. Display only.

label: Cost to own ÷ HUD 80% limit
description: annual_ownership_cost / ami80_income_limit.

label: Rent ÷ HUD 80% limit
description: annual_rent / ami80_income_limit.

label: Home value ÷ town income
description: home_value / town_median_hh_income: years of town income the typical home costs (v1's measure). Not scored.

label: Home value ÷ county income
description: home_value / county_median_hh_income. Not scored.

label: Owning affordable at 80% AMI
description: True if ownership_burden_ami80 is 30% or less.

label: Renting affordable at 80% AMI
description: True if rent_burden_ami80 is 30% or less.

label: Ownership burden percentile
description: Hazen percentile of ownership_burden across towns, flipped so 100 = smallest burden.

label: Rent burden percentile
description: Hazen percentile of rent_burden, flipped so 100 = smallest burden.

label: Cost-burdened renters percentile
description: Percentile of renters_cost_burdened (context only).

label: Ownership measure confidence
description: Reliability of ownership_burden from the ACS coefficient of variation, capped at medium for ACS home values.

label: Rent measure confidence
description: Reliability of rent_burden from the ACS coefficient of variation.

label: Cost-burdened share confidence
description: Reliability of renters_cost_burdened.

label: Ownership score
description: Ownership affordability score (= ownership_burden_pctl). Higher is more affordable.

label: Ownership rank
description: Rank by ownership_score; 1 = most affordable.

label: Ownership score confidence
description: high / medium / low / insufficient data.

label: Ownership confidence reasons
description: Why the ownership confidence is what it is (semicolon-separated).

label: Rental score
description: Rental affordability score (= rent_burden_pctl). Higher is more affordable.

label: Rental rank
description: Rank by rental_score; 1 = most affordable.

label: Rental score confidence
description: high / medium / low / insufficient data.

label: Rental confidence reasons
description: Why the rental confidence is what it is.

label: Ownership rank, likely best
description: 5th percentile of the ownership rank over 1,000 redraws of the ACS inputs within their margins of error (always includes the published rank).

label: Ownership rank, likely worst
description: 95th percentile of the ownership rank over the same redraws.

label: Rental rank, likely best
description: 5th percentile of the rental rank over 1,000 redraws.

label: Rental rank, likely worst
description: 95th percentile of the rental rank over 1,000 redraws.

label: Zoning restrictiveness index
description: NZLUD zoning restrictiveness (higher = more restrictive). 105 towns.

label: Minimum lot size rule
description: 1 if the town sets a minimum lot size.

label: One-acre-plus minimum lots
description: 1 if any district requires lots of one acre or more.

label: Inclusionary zoning
description: 1 if the town has inclusionary zoning.

label: Open space requirement
description: 1 if the town requires open space in developments.

label: Accessory units allowed
description: 1 if accessory dwelling units are allowed anywhere in the town.

label: Parking required per home
description: Median parking spaces required per residential unit.

label: Districts allowing apartments
description: Share of residential districts (incl. mixed use) that allow multifamily housing by right.

label: Zoning data available
description: True for the 105 towns NZLUD covers.

label: Housing region
description: The state's affordable-housing region (Fourth Round).

label: Present need
description: Fourth Round present need (October 2024 calculation).

label: Prospective need (uncapped)
description: Fourth Round prospective need before the state's cap.

label: Prospective need
description: Fourth Round prospective need after the cap (2025-2035 obligation).

label: Qualified Urban Aid
description: True for the 47 towns with no prospective obligation by law.

label: Prospective need per 1,000 households
description: prospective_need_capped / households x 1,000.

label: Total need per 1,000 households
description: (present_need + prospective_need_capped) / households x 1,000.

label: Build date
description: Date the row was built.
